query:
SELECT
                l.macro_id,
                l.email_address::text AS "email_address!",
                COALESCE(g.granted_scopes, '{}') AS "granted_scopes!",
                COALESCE(g.grant_version, 0) AS "grant_version!",
                g.calendar_disabled_at
            FROM email_links l
            LEFT JOIN email_link_google_scopes g ON g.link_id = l.id
            WHERE l.id = $1
            FOR UPDATE OF l
